parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.uuid, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.full_name, p.email, p.phone, p.company, p.title, p.industry, p.company_size, p.location, p.profile_score, p.icp_match, p.decision_maker, p.likely_pain_points, p.public_fact, p.best_angle, p.platform, p.status, p.source, p.tags, p.linkedin_url, p.instagram_username, p.detected_language, p.created_at, c.score as conv_score, c.intent, c.summary as conv_summary, c.requires_human, c.message_history FROM prospects p LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.prospect_id = p.id AND c.score = (SELECT MAX(c2.score) FROM conversations c2 WHERE c2.prospect_id = p.id) WHERE p.status IN ('hot_lead','converted','engaged') AND (p.crm_synced = FALSE OR p.crm_synced IS NULL) AND p.profile_score >= 7 ORDER BY p.profile_score DESC LIMIT 25

INSERT INTO crm_sync (prospect_id, crm_name, crm_contact_id, crm_url, status, score_at_export, payload, crm_response, error_message, last_sync_at, sync_count) VALUES ({{ $json.prospect_id }}, '{{ $json.crm_name }}', {{ $json.crm_contact_id ? "'" + $json.crm_contact_id + "'" : 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.crm_url ? "'" + $json.crm_url + "'" : 'NULL' }}, '{{ $json.status }}', {{ $json.score_at_export }}, '{{ $json.payload_json }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.crm_response_json }}'::jsonb, {{ $json.error_message ? "'" + $json.error_message.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }}, NOW(), 1) ON CONFLICT (prospect_id, crm_name) DO UPDATE SET crm_contact_id = EXCLUDED.crm_contact_id, status = EXCLUDED.status, crm_response = EXCLUDED.crm_response, last_sync_at = NOW(), sync_count = crm_sync.sync_count + 1; UPDATE prospects SET crm_synced = TRUE, crm_synced_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $json.prospect_id }}
